headline: Norris comes out on top after 6 lead changes in Budapest
standfirst: Lando Norris won the Hungarian Grand Prix for McLaren, finishing 15.080s ahead of Max Verstappen, with Kimi Antonelli completing the podium after 70 laps of Hungaroring.

sections.title: The start
sections.body: Lando Norris lined up first on the grid. Piastri got the better launch and led the field across the line at the end of the opening lap. The biggest winner of the opening lap was Lawson, up 3 places to 8th.

sections.title: How it unfolded
sections.body: The lead changed hands 6 times. Laps led: Norris (36), Piastri (25) and Antonelli (9). Norris took the lead for good on lap 46. The race ran green from start to finish.

sections.title: Strategy
sections.body: Norris made 3 stops, running medium → hard → soft tyres. The field made 45 pit stops in total; the quickest stationary time was 2.1s for Stroll on lap 8. 1 of the top 10 finishers got home with one stop or fewer.

sections.title: Movers
sections.body: Lance Stroll made up the most ground, climbing 7 places from 20th to 13th. Timing recorded 262 on-track position changes, 19 of them by Alonso.

sections.title: Retirements
sections.body: Perez (lap 49), Bottas (lap 14) and Piastri (lap 56) failed to finish.

sections.title: Conditions and pace
sections.body: It stayed dry throughout. Track temperature ranged from 46°C to 53°C, with air at 30–32°C. Charles Leclerc set the fastest lap, a 1:22.000 on lap 58.
